about.metaTitle: About Us | Galata KGK — Istanbul Galata University
about.metaDescription: Discover the interdisciplinary community, vision, mission and long-term ambitions of Istanbul Galata University Career and Entrepreneurship Club.
about.heroTitle: Turning curiosity into action and connections into opportunity.
about.heroDescription: Galata KGK is where students come together to shape their careers with intention and experience entrepreneurship first-hand.
about.introTitle: Built by students, for the futures students want to create.
about.introParagraphs:
At Istanbul Galata University Career and Entrepreneurship Club, we help students discover the world of work while they are still at university, evaluate career options with intention and step into professional life with confidence.

We bring together students from dentistry, gastronomy, nursing, business, communication, design, computer engineering and public relations. By combining the perspective of every discipline, we create a more inclusive and powerful learning environment.
about.principleText: When knowledge and perspectives from different disciplines meet, every student's career journey becomes richer.
about.visionTitle: A sustainable career community that connects disciplines.
about.visionDescription: We aim to become a trusted, pioneering campus community where students from different departments learn from one another, build meaningful relationships with the world of work and grow consistently every term.
about.missionTitle: Building career confidence through experience, guidance and strong relationships.
about.missionDescription: Through professional conversations, summits, workshops and collaborations, we help students understand industries up close, strengthen their capabilities and meet the right professionals in their fields.
about.timelineTitle: A community designed to grow with purpose.
about.timelineDescription: Our growth plan prioritises consistent activity, a strong team structure and lasting partnerships over short-lived crowds.

privacy.metaTitle: Cookie and Analytics Notice | Galata KGK
privacy.title: Cookie and analytics notice
privacy.description: A transparent overview of the technical tools used to run the site and understand its performance.
privacy.sessionDescription: Public pages do not use visitor accounts or persistent preference cookies. The protected admin panel uses only the technically essential Auth.js session cookie required to maintain a secure administrator session.
privacy.analyticsDescription: Vercel Web Analytics measures aggregate information such as page views, general device categories and referral sources in an anonymised form.
privacy.performanceDescription: Vercel Speed Insights measures loading performance and Core Web Vitals so we can improve the site. These scripts are not loaded inside the admin panel.
privacy.marketingDescription: This site does not use advertising networks, social-media tracking pixels, personalised advertising or behavioural profiling cookies.
